name: pda-bliss-platform
description: PDA BLISS COMPANY LIMITED — corporate platform with a private client workspace experience.

scripts.build: npm --workspace backend run build && npm --workspace frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm --workspace backend run start" "npm --workspace frontend run preview"
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace backend run typecheck && npm --workspace frontend run typecheck
